title: Market Chatter: Kuwait Petroleum Held Talks With Investors Over Potential $7 Billion Pipeline Deal

summary: Kuwait Petroleum had early talks with investors like BlackRock (BLK), KKR (KKR), EIG Partners, and B
summary_zh: 科威特石油公司与 BlackRock (BLK)、KKR (KKR)、EIG Partners 和 B 等投资者进行了早期谈判

title: Nvidia beats on Q4 expectations and offers better-than-anticipated Q1 outlook
title_zh: 英伟达第四季度业绩好于预期，第一季度前景好于预期
summary: Nvidia reported its Q4 earnings on Wednesday.

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
